text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.06.14-rc2 -> production started (canary 7% eu-west). Post-deploy quick-smoke running: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3654321000

anita: qa-bot alerted: healthcheck probe `/healthz` for generate-svc returning 502 intermittently during smoke. Probe id health-mini-21. 6/40 failures.

derek: 502 from ingress or app? Logs show `upstream connect error or disconnect` in proxy for the failed attempts.

qa-bot: Summary: window 10m, total probes 40, failures 6 (15%), failure pattern concentrated on 2 nodes.

infra-bot: Autoscaler events: node pool eu-west-gen scaled down by 2 during deployment window and then scaled up. Timing overlaps failures. kube-evict logs show ephemeral node replacements at T+2m.

anita: That could explain upstream disconnects if connections dropped mid-request. Options: 1) pin eu-west to stable 2) roll back canary 3) pause ramp and increase sampling 4) hotfix to change readiness/grace period.

derek: prefer pin eu-west to stable to reduce customer risk, keep rollout elsewhere. Also extend readiness grace on canary release to avoid churn triggering probe failures.

ops-oncall: Agreed. Execute region pin and increase synthetic sampling to 200/10m to validate. Also notify SRE about node churn during warmup.

infra-bot: Executing: `pin-route --region eu-west --route /generate --target v2026.06.12-stable --reason "intermittent 502s during post-deploy smoke coincident with node churn"` Request approved by ops-oncall.

qa-bot: After pin: sampling increased. New sample in 5m scheduled.

anita: Creating Jira RD-5015 "post-deploy healthcheck 502s eu-west due to node churn; adjust readiness/grace" and assigning to infra and runtime.

derek: I'll prepare a small PR to bump readiness timeout and add a short backoff on upstream dial. We'll test in staging before applying to canary.

infra-bot: Action items summary: eu-west pinned to v2026.06.12-stable (applied), sampling increased to 200/10m, RD-5015 created (https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/RD-5015), global ramp paused for eu-west until triage or 13:30 UTC (owner: anita).

anita: Release notes edit for v2026.06.14-rc2: "eu-west generate-route temporarily pinned to v2026.06.12-stable after post-deploy healthcheck probes detected intermittent 502s during node churn; rollout paused for eu-west pending infra triage."

ops-oncall: Thanks team. Keep thread open and post staging test results.

derek: will post PR link and staging smoke logs by 12:50 UTC.

anita: closing loop once RD-5015 resolved. Good catch by smoke harness. :thumbsup:
